AWPTCM-T43849.objective:
• The DUT responds to ARPs on an interface for other IP hosts that would be on the same interface (one-armed router scenario, e.g. private VLANs), using the DUT MAC address.
  • With "ip local-proxy-arp" enabled on the interface, a ping from a host on the same subnet to another host on the same subnet via the DUT results in ARP resolution using the DUT MAC.
  • The feature is off by default; enabling it allows local proxy ARP behavior.
  • Local proxy ARP works over static and dynamic LAGs when configured on the LAG interface.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability.

Configure DUT and BackupSW on VLAN 23. On DUT: ip address 23.1.1.1/24; ip local-proxy-arp. On BackupSW: ip address 23.1.1.2/16. From BackupSW, ping 23.1.1.3. Verify ping fails but ARP table on BackupSW shows DUT MAC for the target.
Verify the command "ip local-proxy-arp" is accepted and shown in running config; confirm it is off by default.
Test over static LAG and dynamic LAG interfaces; verify DUT responds to ARPs for hosts on the LAG.
